# Roamr voice agents 24/7

> Global Voice agents wherever life takes you.

Roamr is a self-serve, multi-tenant Grok 2.0 voice-agent platform. Website: https://www.roamr.mobile

## Product
- Personal assistant, sales, support and other high-value voice agents
- Full Grok voice stack: grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 speech-to-speech, TTS, STT
- 25 languages, 16 flagship voices, custom / cloned voices
- Knowledge base, guardrails, Google Workspace and other integrations
- Twilio local numbers
- Client console + owner operator desk
- Stripe billing, monthly or annual

## Pricing (USD)
- Starter $49/mo or $470/yr — 1 agent, 200 min, 1 number
- Growth $149/mo or $1,430/yr — 5 agents, 1,000 min, 3 numbers, all languages
- Scale $399/mo or $3,830/yr — 25 agents, 5,000 min, 10 numbers, custom voices
- Overage $0.18–$0.28 / min depending on plan
- 7-day trial with 50 minutes

## Languages
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, Swedish, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Czech, Romanian, Ukrainian, Greek, Hebrew, Bengali.
